What a crazy weekend we had… Microsoft went dark. A bomb was found inside an Illinois ethanol plant. Iran is ramping up open threats to assassinate President Trump. And over 7,000 flights were grounded nationwide.

Social media enflamed the panic. We were hacked! It’s a dry run for a false flag attack! It’s aliens!

We have to separate the real threats from the noise. The bomb in Peoria and the Iranian plots are completely real. The grounded planes were real too, but it doesn’t look like it was a hack. It was outdated equipment from 2001 and human error. It was the same thing with Microsoft, just a bad network upgrade. Yet look at how fast everyone jumped to the worst possible conclusion.

The problem is that nobody believes the official story anymore because our institutions have completely destroyed their own credibility. When trust dies, people panic and start shooting at searchlights and smoke while the real enemy picks its moment.

But the time for panicking is over. The real warning signs are already flashing, and losing your head over every rumor on your feed will not keep you safe. Be prepared, because I don’t think this is the end of the chaos. But don’t panic.

A mother in Wisconsin was passed out so deeply by the pool that police couldn't wake her, while her 3 kids kept swimming. When she finally opened her eyes, she swore she hadn't taken anything, then threatened to have an officer's whole family killed.

Other residents had already tried to shake her awake for at least 15 minutes before they called for help. Some of them had watched her earlier, slapping the kids on the head in the pool and grabbing at them, before she collapsed into the chair. One neighbor recognized her: she'd been fired from his clinic a few months earlier for showing up to work disoriented.

Officers didn't believe her story for a second. Even sternum rubs hadn't woken her, and her pupils were pinpoint. When they asked how she could know her kids were okay if she'd been asleep, the 37-year-old refused to give her name, demanded a search warrant, and told one officer that a single phone call could end his life.

She was arrested for disorderly conduct and threats to law enforcement, and relatives came to take the children.

She kept asking what she did wrong, while her kids watched her get handcuffed.

Watch how a simple welfare check at a swimming pool turned into an arrest.

PEORIA, IL — New details are emerging about the arrest of 41-year-old Andrew Kozak, a Chillicothe resident and employee of BioUrja Renewables, who is accused of planting a deadly explosive device at the ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois, on Friday, November 13, 2026.

According to News 25 WEEK, Kozak was arrested Monday morning, November 16, when he arrived for work at the very facility where he is accused of planting the bomb just three days earlier.

Investigators reportedly believe Kozak planted the explosive device Friday before sending an electronic bomb threat to the company.

Authorities ultimately discovered the device and determined the threat was credible, triggering a massive emergency response that forced thousands of nearby residents and businesses to evacuate over the weekend.

Despite the extensive investigation and evacuation, Kozak allegedly returned to work Monday morning as though nothing had happened. Law enforcement sources suggested he may have been attempting to avoid suspicion by maintaining his normal routine.

Meanwhile, FBI agents executed a search warrant at Kozak’s residence in Chillicothe, Illinois, as part of the ongoing federal investigation.

Additional information has emerged regarding Kozak’s criminal history.

According to the online records, Kozak was previously convicted of felony burglaries involving two public high schools in Polk County, Nebraska.

He was sentenced to one to three years in state prison for those offenses.

As of Monday evening, November 16, Peoria County Jail records list Kozak as being held on an FBI hold, with federal authorities leading the investigation.

Law enforcement sources now say they expect federal charges to be filed against Kozak as early as Monday night.

The specific charges have not yet been announced.

The investigation remains ongoing, and authorities have not publicly established a motive for the alleged attempt to bomb the ethanol facility.

Kozak remains presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.

Senator Sanders @SenSanders I'm a surgeon. Let me tell you what Medicare for All means from inside the operating room.

Medicare already pays doctors 33% less than it did in 2001, adjusted for the cost of running a practice. It cut us again for 2027. 

Third year in a row.

That one payer is why private practice fell from 80% of doctors to less than 20%. Why your doctor now works for a hospital system with a quota. Why I spent six hours last Friday trying to get one patient seen.

Medicare for All takes the payer that did that and makes it the only one. Nobody to negotiate with. Nowhere else to send the patient. One rate, set in Washington, for every surgeon in America.

CBO looked at it. Their words: demand for care would rise faster than the supply of doctors and hospitals. Universal coverage is not universal access. A card in your wallet is not an appointment.

And the 68,000 deaths? That's a computer model, not a body count. Here's a number that isn't a model: Medicare Advantage denied 200 of 207 of the sickest patients at one hospital system last year. Government-contracted. Government-paid.

I'm not defending insurance companies. I've spent two weeks on this feed showing what they do. But the answer to a bad insurer isn't one insurer with no competition and a 33% pay cut baked in.

The answer is a system where the doctor can still say "send her to me." Medicare for All is the last system where that's possible, and the first where it isn't. @Doctor4Patients #MedicareForAll

UPDATE: Baby Koah survived being buried alive in a dog crate. Now we’re learning more about what happened in the weeks leading up to his disappearance.

Koah (11 months) was rescued from a shallow grave on his grandfather’s property in Batesburg-Leesville, South Carolina, after investigators heard him crying beneath the dirt.

His father, Michael Comer (25), is charged with attempted murder and other offenses.

Koah survived and was reunited with his mother, Dezarae Sharp.

But there are new details about the circumstances leading up to his disappearance.

Dezarae had already ended her relationship with Comer following a domestic violence incident in May. According to court records, Comer assaulted her while she was holding Koah. She contacted police, and Comer subsequently pleaded guilty.

He later spent time in jail following a separate altercation.

After his release, Comer’s mother assured Dezarae that he had stopped drinking, was taking medication, and wanted to see his son.

Dezarae eventually agreed to weekend visits involving Comer and his mother.

Dezarae has also moved on with her life. She is pregnant with her second child, whose father is another man. 

In the weeks before Koah disappeared, Comer sent messages expressing jealousy and wanting to reunite with Dezarae.

“I don’t want to take him. I want us to be a family,” he wrote.

Dezarae told him to stop contacting her.

On Monday, Koah was supposed to be returned to his mother. He never arrived.

That morning, Comer had contacted his estranged father, John, asking for a ride and somewhere to stay.

John brought Michael and Koah to his property. He later described the baby as hungry, thirsty, and crying, with a dirty diaper.

John left for work, leaving Michael alone with Koah.

By that afternoon, both were missing.

Michael was eventually located, but Koah was nowhere to be found.

Investigators searched the property, and the following day they discovered disturbed dirt. As rescuers began digging, they heard Koah crying.

That little boy was still alive.

At Comer’s bond hearing, a detective testified that he showed no remorse when informed his son had survived.

Comer remains in custody facing attempted murder and other charges.

Meanwhile, Dezarae has been dealing with a serious pregnancy-related illness while trying to recover from what happened to her baby. 

And now she’s facing accusations from people who believe she should never have allowed Koah to visit his father. 

There are questions about the visitation arrangements that still need answers.

But Dezarae reported the previous violence, ended the relationship, and was reportedly assured that Comer was receiving treatment.

She did not bury Koah in that dog crate.

Michael Comer is the person charged with attempting to murder his own son.

Koah survived. His mother has her baby back.

And I hope they both get the opportunity to recover in peace. Nobody is perfect. Give mom some space to figure things out.

.@paulfchristiano thinks that on the current trajectory (absent any slowing down), there is a 1 in 3 chance that we could have superintelligence powerful enough to overthrow the government within a year. (He articulates a concrete scenario).

He argues that the labs should pause further algorithmic progress until they can secure their weights and research secrets. Otherwise China could simply steal the superintelligence in the middle of the intelligence explosion, and the labs would no longer be able to slow down even if they saw their models going off the rails.

He also explains how AIs will be trained during the intelligence explosion, and why even a system trained entirely inside a data center could still have the capabilities profile such that humans would have very little chance of competing with it or controlling it.

And he discusses the plan for alignment - basically, making a superintelligence that actually does what we ask the way we mean it. Fixing reward hacks and building better graders will help up till the next few model generations, but he thinks that no single current approach has better than even odds of letting us control superintelligence. The hope is that the AIs figure out the solution to this problem during the intelligence explosion.

Paul is head of the Alignment Research Center. Previously, he was head of AI safety at the US AI Safety Institute. Before that, he led alignment at OpenAI, where he invented RLHF. He’s recently joined OpenAI’s board (though here he is speaking as a private citizen).

最近硅谷两大佬因为马斯克吵翻了，结果老马亲自下场，一句话把全网看乐了。

先是著名反垄断评论家 Matt 泼冷水：SpaceX 算什么奇迹？马斯克根本不是天才，无非是会找华尔街搞钱，用钞票和工程师硬堆出来的。

这话连平时谁都不服的硅谷传奇程序员 DHH 都看不下去了，直接回怼：太酸了！哪怕你不喜欢马斯克，也得承认他“把吹过的牛变成现实”的能力举世无双。从特斯拉、脑机接口到 SpaceX，世上有一百万个会搞钱的投资人，但只有一个马斯克。

随后马斯克本尊下场，只回了一句灵魂反问：“行，那你给我解释一下蓝色起源、波音和 ULA？”

这一刀，直接捅在了“唯金钱论”的肺管子上。

如果光靠砸钱就能上天，那现在的太空霸主绝不可能是 SpaceX：
1、 比谁更有钱？ 贝索斯的蓝色起源比 SpaceX 早成立两年，背后站着前世界首富，从来不缺钱，结果到现在还在努力追赶。

2、 比谁补贴多？ NASA 当年搞载人航天，同一个任务，给波音砸了 42 亿美元，给 SpaceX 只给了 26 亿。结果 SpaceX 从 2020 年就开始像公交车一样送宇航员上天，波音的飞船却连宇航员都接不回来，最后还得靠 SpaceX 去救场。

3、 比华尔街输血？ SpaceX 起步根本没有华尔街一分钱，全是马斯克卖掉 PayPal 后自己掏的 1 亿美元家底。猎鹰 1 号连炸三次后差点破产，第四次才绝处逢生。

DHH 说得太对了：钱能买来顶级工程师，但买不来“不怕炸火箭”的魄力。

看看星舰第 15 次试飞（Flight 15）就懂了：同一个任务里，助推器在海里丢了，但飞船却从轨道返航、被发射塔的“机械筷子”稳稳夹住。

放在传统航天巨头那里，“丢了助推器”这半句话，就够他们停飞开两年的事故批斗会了；但在 SpaceX，这只是通往成功的又一组实验数据。

@elonmusk 说实话，到底哪个更难造：是一枚能上天的火箭，还是一家“允许工程师靠炸火箭来试错”的公司？

The first two features Matt Palmer walks through in his What's new in Grok Bot 1.0 video this morning, Team Bot improvements and bots that join your meetings, are the same two things I asked for right here on X. On August 30 I wrote that we need to be able to share Grok Bots across teams, and Elon replied "Coming soon." On October 25 I suggested the Grok Bot team let my bot join a Zoom or Teams call with me, or for me, and Elon replied "This might be possible." Meetings started switching on for users less than two weeks later, and now both features lead the 1.0 release.

That says a lot about how responsive this team is. A user describes a need, Elon weighs in himself, and within weeks it is in the product and getting better. Any bot can now become a Team Bot at the flip of a switch, you choose exactly who it is shared with, and a new analytics tab shows the hours it has saved. In a meeting, the bot listens, answers in the chat and picks up spoken instructions, pulling what you need from your connected tools while the meeting is still going. The tempo of Grok Bot's evolution is extraordinary. And these are only two of the many new features in 1.0, so watch Matt's video to see just how fast Grok Bot is improving. I'm grateful to Matt, the team and Elon for listening.

WASHINGTON, DC : PRESENTING NIGERIA’S DEVELOPMENT AND DEMOCRATIC FUTURE ON THE GLOBAL STAGE. 

Yesterday, Monday, November 16, I arrived in Washington, DC, for a series of significant meetings and engagements with congressional leaders from both the U.S. House of Representatives and the Senate, as well as other influential American figures. These discussions focused on vital matters affecting Nigeria’s development, the well-being of our people, and the future of our democracy.

I began the day with a substantive interview with renowned American television commentator Glenn Beck. Our conversation addressed Nigeria’s challenges, the pressing need for accountable leadership, the responsible management of our vast human and natural resources, and the opportunities to establish Nigeria among the world’s leading nations.

I also met with prominent American leaders, including Congressman Marlin Stutzman, Congresswoman Beth Van Duyne, Congressman Todd Tiahrt, Suzanne Bock Grisham, retired U.S. Army Colonel Albert V. Short, and other esteemed stakeholders.

One of the day’s principal highlights was my address on Capitol Hill, during which I underscored the urgent importance of international cooperation and support for Nigeria’s advancement, particularly in the areas of national unity, security, economic prosperity, and the welfare of our citizens.

Our conversations also addressed the protection of Nigeria’s emerging democracy and the strengthening of democratic institutions to ensure elections are free, fair, transparent, and credible, accurately reflecting the will of the Nigerian people.

Nigeria has immense potential to emerge as a leading nation within the global community. What is urgently required is accountable leadership, responsible stewardship of our resources, resilient institutions, and an authentic commitment to the security, unity, and well-being of every Nigerian.

Throughout these engagements, my message remained unequivocal: Nigerians must determine Nigeria’s future. Every vote must be counted, the rights of every citizen must be safeguarded, and the people’s will must consistently prevail.

I remain encouraged by these engagements and firmly committed to working with Nigerians at home and in the diaspora, alongside our international partners, to build a peaceful, secure, united, and prosperous Nigeria.

Our journey continues. Our determination remains steadfast.
